text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The arrangement was incredible.
The moment I heard it, everything clicked right into place, and I wrote the lyrics in one sitting."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be performing the new track at an event.
Please come through if you can—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I see, a daytime event that minors can attend. So those exist.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So curfew doesn't matter, and it's not illegal. Not like I owe you an explanation in the first place, though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that, but you were trying to sneak out so suspiciously... I just couldn't resist, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still... I see, hmm... A music event with a DJ sounds fascinating. Mind if I tag along to learn a thing or two!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —So why the hell did we end up with this crew in the end...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy ayyy☆
We're all hitting up the same event together, right☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't give a damn. Also... Sky, what're you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why~?
Ahaha~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She's my plus-one☆ I was actually lookin' for Flower-chan, but Sky was right there, y'know?
Total catch, ayyy! Total score☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Umm~, events like this are kinda a first for me, though.
I wonder if it's actually fun~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Who knows. You'll find out when we get there.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Pheeew☆
Man, that seriously blew my mind!!
So hyped up it's crazy hot in here!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was even more fascinating than I'd imagined.
Especially the first performer—she expressed her feelings wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! The girl who debuted today, right?!
She wasn't really a party animal type, but man, it hit right in the feels~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Which part?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, like how the track she called her new song and the lyrics clicked so perfectly?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Both the music and lyrics were kinda downer and mellow... but it was still totally fire-tier! Real passion is always so hot☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I remember that track well too.
I believe it featured live orchestral recordings, and they used them lavishly yet kept it so elegant.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Listening to it even brought a sense of warmth. How about you, Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm~... Honestly, I'm not great with noisy crowds and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, today was... really interesting.
Seeing someone bare their soul like that, y'know?
That kind of music isn't bad at all~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To vent all my despair,
I had the absolute best beat made for me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, I'm climbing up.
That's why I'm gonna pour it all out, so it pierces right through everyone here—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (...Even I have to admit it's illogical. That track was only completed the moment she sang it in that space and people listened... To think I'd actually feel that way.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
("Climbing up"—yeah, exactly. Both she and I know full well what answer we're after.
In that case... all that's left is to keep proving it.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: By the way, isn't this group crazy rare?! How 'bout we ride this hype straight to an after-party, yeah?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...As long as it's not ramen.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...!
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then how about that newly opened food theme park?
Apparently they have an eat-until-100%-full challenge event going on!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur & Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not a damn chance.
I think I'll pass on that~
